free_tier.stated: TEE compute on workerpools paid per execution in RLC, split between the app provider, the data provider, the workerpool and gas. The free lane is testnet only: 'Get 5 RLC tokens per claim on Arbitrum Sepolia testnet', with GitHub authentication, a 24-hour cooldown and 'Balance verification (max 1 RLC)'.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: A workerpool order with all price fields at 0 accepts only free resources, so a testnet run can be assembled at zero token cost; the same setting on mainnet finds no worker, because no provider serves for nothing.

limits.value: The faucet pays 5 RLC per claim with a 24-hour cooldown and a wallet balance check capped at 1 RLC, and the tokens buy only Arbitrum Sepolia executions, so no production job can run on the free lane.

identity_cost.detail: a GitHub account is the gate on the free lane: the faucet documentation states "Get 5 RLC tokens per claim on Arbitrum Sepolia testnet" with GitHub authentication, a 24-hour cooldown and a balance check capped at 1 RLC, and the tokens buy testnet executions only. Mainnet capacity needs RLC bought on an exchange, and the record does not state whether that purchase or the mainnet account requires KYC, a phone or an identity document; no card, hold, debit or prepaid statement appears

evidence.proved: read directly: 'Get 5 RLC tokens per claim on Arbitrum Sepolia testnet', GitHub authentication, 24-hour cooldown, balance verification with a max of 1 RLC, testnet only
four cost components per execution: app fee, data fee, workerpool fee and gas, all in nRLC; default max prices are 0, which accepts only free resources
RLC USD 0.657628, so a 5 RLC claim is about USD 3.29 of testnet token with no market value

notes: iExec is the cheapest TEE execution lane found here only if a provider publishes a 0-price order; none was found. Mainnet capacity needs RLC bought on an exchange. Whether the Sepolia workerpool has live workers was not tested; that needs a funded testnet wallet and an order match.
